notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.
